finding.text: The cause is found from the record and fixed at the cause: `Servex/agents/page_tools.js:417` SESSION_KEYS lacked `place`, so every `{place}` call was refused ("names no method, field or child of Session"), as `session.jsonl` line 3 says with transcript line numbers. I ran `node Servex/agents/item_tool.test.mjs` on `worktree/dictation-place`: 103 checks pass.
The fix is in `page_tools.js`, which is outside the brief's fence. The minion said so in its log line, and the cause really is there, so this is the right call.

The `{summary:{card,…}}` special case (`page_tools.js:903`) sends the line down the write path only when the argument has a `card` key. That works, but it leaves one key with two meanings: an empty object is the read-only summary query, and an object with a card is a line to write. Naming the voice line something else (e.g. `fold`) in the skill, `chat.js:214` and `Widget` would remove the clash. When the browser replays such a line, `Item.set` will call `Task.summary()` and throw the result away. That is harmless, but it is still a side effect.

`ux/Dictate/doc/voice-assistant.md:36` still says chat() hands "{chat}, {para}, {place}", but `chat.js:214` also routes `{summary}`. This was already stale before this diff; it is a one-word fix next to the line this diff edited (`:35`).

The `{"commit":"0dabbe1bf332"}` line in `session.jsonl` names only the first commit. The second one (`f52c41892`, the summary fix) is on the branch but has no line in the task log. The task also has no landing/outcome line yet. A fresh agent can still continue from the folder, because the log line plus `git log worktree/dictation-place` tell the whole story.

It goes live only after a merge and a Servex restart, and neither has been done, as the brief says. The 58 sentences already in `sessions/2026/10/25/v-xhx7fmx/session.jsonl` stay unplaced. Nothing replays them, and the brief did not ask for that.
